title: Even part in the first coordinate
statement: For a function $f : \{−1,1\}^{n+1} \to \mathbb{R}$ and a point $x \in \{−1,1\}^n$, define its even part in the first coordinate to be half the sum of the values of $f$ at the two points whose first coordinates are $1$ and $-1$, respectively, and whose remaining coordinates are $x$.
